name: (06) Mytherceria — 3 Advanced — Elder Mytherceria: Steal the Mind

system.description:
Reaching past every guard and lock, you plunder the depths of another's psyche for any memory it holds — even those he has repressed or another has erased with Dominate.

Make eye contact, spend a Willpower Trait and initiate a Mental Challenge. If you succeed, you gain full access to all of the victim's memories, and he becomes comatose (if mortal) or torporous (if Cainite); Static Mental Challenges may be needed to find suppressed or erased information. You retain his memories for one hour, extendable at the rate of one additional hour per Willpower Trait spent, and may release him at any time. While you hold his mind you gain Knowledgeable Mental Traits equal to one-third of his total Mental Traits (rounded down), but suffer an equal number of Oblivious Negative Mental Traits from carrying two sets of memories. Awareness serves for retests.
system.duration: One hour per Willpower Trait spent
